item.title: Clarksburg business owners divided as road work grants roll out
item.description: Earlier this year, the City of Clarksburg approved one-time grants for select businesses that have been affected by lengthy construction within the city, a topic that has been divisive among local business owners.

item.title: $4 billion coming to West Virginia for new 'intelligence center'
item.description: West Virginia Governor Patrick Morrisey announced what he's calling a major economic development win for the Mountain State that could bring new jobs and set the stage for future growth.

item.title: Treasurer Pack recognizes volunteers for 'Get a Life' program
item.description: West Virginia State Treasurer Larry Pack visited Clarksburg on Thursday to recognize volunteers for “Get a Life,” a finance simulation that comes to middle schools all across the state in an effort to teach students about fiscal responsibility.

item.title: 30+ grams of 'suspected cocaine' found during Morgantown traffic stop; man charged
item.description: A man has been arrested and is facing charges after West Virginia State Troopers say he was found with more than 30 grams of suspected cocaine while driving with a revoked license.

item.title: Statewide camping ban bill heads to West Virginia House
item.description: Following in the footsteps of some north central West Virginia cities, a highly debated statewide camping ban bill is making its way through the West Virginia Legislature.

item.title: Utility advocates work with West Virginia lawmakers on ratepayer bill of rights
item.description: Utility advocates are flipping the switch on better transparency for West Virginia consumers.

item.title: Morgantown man gets maximum sentence for distributing child porn
item.description: A Morgantown man will spend two decades behind bars after being convicted of receiving and possessing child pornography.

item.title: DOJ sues West Virginia for withholding voter ID data
item.description: The United States Department of Justice (DOJ) has filed suit against five states, including West Virginia, for not producing full voter registration lists upon request.

item.title: 3 sent to hospital after 2 wrecks in Harrison County at the same intersection
item.description: At least three people were taken to the hospital on Thursday following two separate wrecks at the exact same intersection in Harrison County.

item.title: 6 displaced after fire damages Clarksburg home
item.description: Six people have been displaced after a fire broke out at a Clarksburg home Thursday evening.
